Here are some examples of the cost to study a master's in Finland as an international student:

- **Accessible and Sustainable Digital Services, Computing Sciences and Electrical Engineering, Master of Science (2 yrs)** at Tampere University: €12,000 per year [Opintopolku / Studyinfo](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/koulutus/1.2.246.562.13.00000000000000012723)
- **Accounting and Auditing, Master of Science (Economics and Business Administration) (2 years)** at University of Vaasa: €14,000 per year [Opintopolku / Studyinfo](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/koulutus/1.2.246.562.13.00000000000000001318)
- **Accounting and Finance, Master of Science (Economics and Business Administration) (2 years)** at University of Eastern Finland: €12,000 per year [Opintopolku / Studyinfo](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/koulutus/1.2.246.562.13.00000000000000007904)
- **Accounting, Master of Science (Economics and Business Administration) (2 yrs)** at Aalto University: €15,000 per year [Opintopolku / Studyinfo](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/koulutus/1.2.246.562.13.00000000000000002702)
- **Acoustics and Audio Technology, Master of Science (Technology) (2 yrs)** at Aalto University: €17,000 per year [Opintopolku / Studyinfo](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/koulutus/1.2.246.562.13.00000000000000002744)

These figures are verified as of November 22, 2026. Tuition fees can vary depending on the programme and institution. 

Sources:
- [Opintopolku / Studyinfo (Finnish National Agency for Education)](https://opintopolku.fi/konfo/en/)
